snippet.title: Lord Ambermaze - Official Release Date Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out minigames, dating sim mechanics, and more from Lord Ambermaze in this latest trailer for the upcoming adventure RPG featuring a turn-based combat system and time manipulation mechanics – only your steps can force the flow of time to move. Delve into the depths of the underworld to challenge the evil Lord and restore time. Lord Ambermaze will be available on PC (Steam) on August 14.
